blind.description: A stylized wooden carpenter's workbench with four chunky legs, a lower shelf holding a blue-and-red chest/toolbox, and a screw vise handle on the left end. On top of the bench rests a long light-wood board being worked on, a wooden hand plane with a dark blade, a wooden mallet, and curled wood shavings gathered near the right end. The model features clean, solid geometry with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A horizontal rectangular wooden table surface with four small rectangular bench dog holes, a vise screw sticking out from the left edge, a lighter wooden plank across the center with a hand plane and mallet on it, and curled shavings clustered on the right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the figure, roughly 3 ft tall (around half the figure's height), and approximately 4.5 to 5 ft long.
